proposed_widenings.name: permanent_grant family for ClassFeatureMechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: Epic Boon is a one-time character-progression grant that happens at level-up. It is not activated, has no use-count resource, no rest-reset cadence, and no fixed-effect payload. The current ClassFeatureMechanics type only models the 'activation' family (activationCost + resource + resetCadence + effect), which is structurally wrong for any passive/permanent progression grant. A new family such as 'permanent_grant' or 'level_grant' is needed to cover all level-X 'you gain a feat' or 'you gain a permanent capability' entries.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_feat (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: Even if a 'permanent_grant' family were added, the effect payload would need a 'grant_feat' atom to express 'player chooses one feat from a named category (Epic Boon feats) or any qualifying feat'. No such atom exists in v4 or in the current ClassFeatureEffect union. The recommended feat (Boon of Irresistible Offense) is advisory, not the mechanical content — the core mechanic is an open feat choice.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Irresistible Offense is recommended.

notes: Epic Boon (and the parallel L19 feature on every other SRD class) is a recurring pattern: a permanent, non-activatable feat grant at level-up. The 'activation' family is categorically inapplicable — there is nothing to activate, no resource consumed, no rest that refills anything. This is the same structural gap as an ASI entry. Every class's L19 Epic Boon will hit this same wall. A single 'permanent_grant' family addition would resolve all of them.
